doc: The cutover harness's abstract rows (HolonCutover.t.sol), read by holon.cutover.corpus: the row op of each action of the versioned member, its argument template after [op, who], and the planted waits. Template tokens: k the trace's last committed batch index, k+1 the next one, root(k) and root(k+1) the post-state roots the corpus gives them (the genesis post-state root plus the index), deposit the challenge deposit of the version's registry; integers are literal.
